accounting.correctness: exact full-key comparisons after tag matches, first-witness lookup samples, equal state and root counts, and equal target outcomes
accounting.index_build: target-independent S3 roots, canonical roots, sparse bucket sorting, singleton tags, and candidate-only batched rational lifts of indexed roots and polynomial x/y storage
accounting.target_query: target-dependent query preparation, batched S3 or point-addition partner generation, partner canonicalization, exact tag filtering, and relation checks
accounting.target_residual: outer target-stage time minus the three exclusive query, partner-generation, and partner-check clocks; nested canonicalization and lookup diagnostics are null in both arms

claim_boundary: bounded one-target N83 root-index stage comparing a target-independent Frobenius-orbit membership filter with exact cached-coordinate lookup; retain outer target, CPU, and exclusive phase clocks
comparison_variable: candidate inserts every Frobenius conjugate of each indexed polynomial root into a 256 MiB two-bit-per-word blocked Bloom filter before the target clock; a negative filter answer skips basis conversion and canonical lookup, while every possible hit follows the reference exact table lookup and first-witness check. Both arms use the same cached x/y roots, point-partner generation, sparse 24-bit directory, unrolled N83 basis conversion, early-stop canonicalization, 16-byte records, and singleton tags
